name: Denver County, CO
findings: Denver County has 3,618 nonprofit organizations. 1,726 of them (48%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 1,472 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (15% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Denver County has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
